## UDR, Inc. Announces Appointment of Scott McCallum as Executive Vice President – Chief Investment Officer


October 14, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s206.q4cdn.com/293289095/files/content_files/UDR-Inc-Announces-Appointment-of-Scott-McCallum-as-Executive-Vice-President-Chief-Investment-Officer.pdf)


DENVER--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


UDR, Inc. (the “Company”) (NYSE:[UDR](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fir.udr.com%2FStock&esheet=54622268&newsitemid=20261014870941&lan=en-US&anchor=UDR&index=1&md5=9475cc4c8ea14126f26dbbf156d79319) ), a leading multifamily real estate investment trust, today announced that Scott McCallum will join the Company as Executive Vice President - Chief Investment Officer (“EVP-CIO”), effective November 5, 2026. He will report to Thomas W. Toomey, Chairman, President, and Chief Executive Officer of UDR.


Mr. McCallum will bring an extensive background in public and private real estate with a decade of experience in real estate investments across several property types, including his current role focused on new investment opportunities in the multifamily sector. Mr. McCallum joins UDR from Blackstone Inc., the world’s largest alternative asset manager, with more than $1.3 trillion in AUM. He joined Blackstone in 2017, and most recently served as a Managing Director in the Real Estate Group. During his time at the firm, he worked on real estate investments in both Canada and the United States, as well as a variety of other transactions contributing to the growth of Blackstone’s residential platforms in North America. Prior to joining Blackstone, Mr. McCallum was an officer in the United States Navy. He graduated from the United States Naval Academy with a BS in Honors Economics (Arabic minor).


“Scott is a seasoned executive with an exceptional blend of investment and strategic insight. He is well positioned to lead our investment team,” said Tom Toomey, UDR’s Chairman, President, and Chief Executive Officer. “His deep experience in real estate investments and transactions and proven leadership will further enhance our data driven platform capabilities. We are excited to welcome Scott to the team.”


Mr. McCallum shared, “I am honored by the opportunity to serve as UDR’s Executive Vice President - Chief Investment Officer and lead an extremely talented and motivated team.”

**About UDR, Inc.**


UDR, Inc. (NYSE:[UDR](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fir.udr.com%2FStock&esheet=54622268&newsitemid=20261014870941&lan=en-US&anchor=UDR&index=2&md5=7bdf8b9fdf36e35a1216625f912a0bd0) ), an S&P 500 company, is a leading multifamily real estate investment trust with a demonstrated performance history of delivering superior and dependable returns by successfully managing, buying, selling, developing and redeveloping attractive real estate communities in targeted U.S. markets. As of June 30, 2026, UDR owned or had an ownership position in 60,259 apartment homes, including 685 apartment homes under development. For over 54 years, UDR has delivered long-term value to shareholders, the best standard of service to residents, and the highest quality experience for associates. Additional information can be found on the Company’s Investor Relations website at[http://ir.udr.com/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.udr.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54622268&newsitemid=20261014870941&lan=en-US&anchor=http%3A%2F%2Fir.udr.com%2F&index=3&md5=3a8890c695ae9f8d1a629284764746c9) .
